svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make ten, 1,070 mm across the deck by about 686 mm (end panels

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 643 mm). Panel 2 from the gate end has a 86 x 46 mm notch for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame: 40 x 40 x 4 angle welded into a rectangle, legs inward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Underside: 1 mm aluminium sheet riveted under the frame, bright side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down, to reflect heat from the crust. Do not paint it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board: 37 mm calcium silicate cut to fit inside the frame, dry.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: 2 mm steel sheet stitch welded to the frame, light grey

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: anti-slip coating. Drill two 10 mm drain holes at the low corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rests on two bearers, 2 mm gap to the next panel and 5 mm to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the toe boards; two M8 bolts each end into the bearers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: about 25 kg; flat within 3 mm; no gap in the board.
